user.title: Elpris API
user.description:
Connect to data.elprisapi.dk to get Danish hourly electricity prices with the full tariff breakdown.

Your API key is stored in the Home Assistant config entry.

**No API key yet?** Get a free one at [elprisapi.dk/#api-noegle](https://elprisapi.dk/#api-noegle) — it is emailed to you.

data_description.api_key: Free from https://elprisapi.dk/#api-noegle. Sent as the X-Api-Key header to data.elprisapi.dk.
data_description.zone: DK1 is west of the Great Belt (Jutland and Funen); DK2 is east (Zealand and Bornholm).

operator.title: Grid operator
operator.description: Pick your grid operator (netselskab) to include its hourly grid tariff in the total price.

data_description.operator: Choose "No grid operator" to get prices without the grid tariff. If the total price looks too low, this is usually why.

reauth_confirm.title: Elpris API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: data.elprisapi.dk rejected the stored API key. Enter a valid key to continue. A free key is available at [elprisapi.dk/#api-noegle](https://elprisapi.dk/#api-noegle).

error.no_data: No prices returned for this zone and grid operator.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This zone and grid operator are already configured.
